_about: FAQ shown on the homepage. Loaded by syg.js; edit here and it is live in about 2 minutes, no Blogger upload needed. Each item: id (link name), topic, q (question), tldr (one-line answer), steps (numbered), tips (bullets), note (small print). Simple HTML (b, i, a, code) is allowed. Designed & Developed by Nivesh Sahayak (https://www.niveshsahayak.in/).

items.q: How do I join a WhatsApp group using an invite link?
items.tldr: Tap the link, then hit Join group in WhatsApp. That’s literally it 🎉
steps: Find a group you like here: use the search box or tap a category chip.
Tap Join group on its card.
Read the 3 quick safety tips and tap Continue to WhatsApp.
WhatsApp opens the group’s invite page with its name, photo and member count.
Tap Join group. You’re in ✅
tips: On a laptop the link opens WhatsApp Web or the desktop app. Make sure you’re logged in there first.
See Request to join instead? The admin approves members by hand. Tap it and wait.

items.q: How do I find WhatsApp groups to join?
items.tldr: Search by what you’re into, your exam, your city or your language, then filter. 🔎
steps: Type in the search box at the top of the list, e.g. jobs, NEET, cricket, memes, Punjabi or Dubai.
Or tap a category chip like Jobs & Careers, Education & Exams or Gaming.
Use the Groups / Channels switch to see only one kind.
Sort by Newest for fresh groups or A–Z to browse.
Want a city or country? Open our group lists by city, country & topic.
tips: Fresh groups (marked NEW) usually have working links and active admins.
Turn on Auto scroll (bottom right) to keep loading groups as you scroll.

items.q: Why can’t I join a WhatsApp group from a link?
items.tldr: Most of the time the link was reset, the group is full, or the admin has to approve you. 😅
steps: “This invite link was reset” or “Link not valid”: the admin made a new link. Pick another group and tap the 🚩 on the card so we remove it.
“Group is full”: WhatsApp groups max out at 1,024 members. Nothing you can do; try another.
“Request to join”: tap it and wait for an admin to approve you.
You were removed before: only an admin can add you back.
Nothing happens when you tap: update WhatsApp from the Play Store / App Store, then copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari.

items.q: What does “Request to join” mean on a WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: The admin approves every new member by hand. You’re in once they say yes. ⏳
steps: Open the invite link and tap Request to join.
Wait. The admins see your request in the group’s pending list.
Once approved, the group shows up in your Chats.
Changed your mind? Open the same link again and tap Cancel request.
tips: No reply after a day or two? The admin may not be active. Try another group.

items.q: How many members can a WhatsApp group have?
items.tldr: Up to 1,024 members in one group, admins included. 👥
steps: A normal group holds up to 1,024 people.
Need more? Admins use a channel (unlimited followers, one-way posts) or a community that links several groups under one roof.

items.q: Will other members see my phone number in a WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: Yes. In a normal group everyone can see your number. In a channel, nobody can. 👀
steps: Android: tap ⋮ (top right) → Settings → Privacy. iPhone: tap Settings (bottom) → Privacy.
Tap Profile photo → choose My contacts.
Do the same for About and Last seen and online.
Now group strangers see your number but not your photo, bio or last seen.
tips: Want zero exposure? Follow channels instead of joining big public groups.

items.q: Can I join a WhatsApp group without the admin knowing?
items.tldr: Nope. The group shows a note that you joined via the link, and admins see every member. 🙅
steps: Just want to lurk and read updates? Follow a channel instead: nobody sees who follows.
Switch the list here to Channels to find one.

items.q: How do I leave a WhatsApp group quietly?
items.tldr: Exit the group: only the admins get told, not every member. 🤫
steps: Open the group and tap its name at the top.
Scroll all the way down.
Tap Exit group, then Exit again to confirm.
Optional: tap Delete group afterwards to clear the chat from your phone.
tips: Just too many pings? Tap the group name → Notifications / Mute → Always, and stay in.

items.q: How do I stop strangers adding me to WhatsApp groups?
items.tldr: Set who can add you to My contacts in Privacy. Done in 20 seconds. 🔒
steps: Android: ⋮ → Settings → Privacy. iPhone: Settings tab → Privacy.
Tap Groups.
Pick My contacts, or My contacts except… to block certain people too.
Anyone else now has to send you an invite, which you can just ignore.

items.q: What’s the difference between a WhatsApp group and a channel?
items.tldr: Group = two-way chat for up to 1,024 people. Channel = one-way broadcast anyone can follow. 📣
steps: Group: everyone can post, react and see each other’s numbers. Best for chatting.
Channel: only admins post; followers read, react and vote in polls. Your number stays hidden. Best for news, deals and updates.
Here, flip the Groups / Channels switch to see one kind only.

items.q: How do I follow a WhatsApp channel?
items.tldr: Open the channel link and tap Follow. New posts land in your Updates tab. 🔔
steps: Switch the list here to Channels.
Tap Join channel on a card, then Continue to WhatsApp.
Tap Follow.
Open the Updates tab in WhatsApp to read it any time.
tips: To stop: open the channel → tap its name → Unfollow.

items.q: Can WhatsApp channel admins see my phone number?
items.tldr: No. Admins and other followers can’t see your number or profile photo. 🕶️
steps: Admins only see totals: how many followers, and how many people reacted to a post.
Your reactions and poll votes don’t show your name or number to other followers.

items.q: How do I get my WhatsApp channel link?
items.tldr: Open your channel → tap its name → Share → Copy link. 🔗
steps: Open your channel in the Updates tab.
Tap the channel name at the top.
Tap Share (or Share channel link), then Copy link.
It looks like https://whatsapp.com/channel/…. Paste it in the box at the top of this page to list it.

items.q: How do I create or copy a WhatsApp group invite link?
items.tldr: Group name → Invite via link → Copy link. Usually only admins see it. 🔗
steps: Open your group and tap the group name at the top.
Scroll down to Invite via link (iPhone: Invite to group via link).
Tap Copy link. It looks like https://chat.whatsapp.com/…
Same screen also has QR code (great for posters) and Reset link.
tips: Not an admin and can’t see the option? Ask an admin, or ask them to allow everyone to invite in Group settings.

items.q: How do I add my WhatsApp group to ShareYourGroup? Is it free?
items.tldr: 100% free, no account. Paste your link in the box at the top and tap Drop it. 🚀
steps: Copy your group or channel invite link (see the question above).
Paste it in the box at the top of this page, or on the Submit page.
Tick that your group follows the sharing rules.
Pick a category and write one line about your group.
Tap Publish. We pull the name and photo from WhatsApp for you.

items.q: How long does it take for my group to show up?
items.tldr: Instantly. Your card pops up at the top as soon as you publish. ⚡
steps: You see your card at the top of the list right away.
Everyone else sees it the next time they open or refresh the page.
If WhatsApp is slow to share the name and photo, they fill in within about 15 minutes.

items.q: How can I get more members for my WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: Clear name, real photo, active chat, and share it everywhere your people hang out. 📈
steps: Give it a clear name that says what it is, e.g. Delhi Data Analyst Jobs, not Best Group 🔥🔥.
Use a real group photo; it’s the first thing people see on your card.
Write a description that says who it’s for and how often you post.
Pin your rules inside the group and post regularly; dead groups lose members fast.
Share your card with the share button: Instagram bio, Stories, Facebook, Telegram, your WhatsApp Status.
Submit the same link again once a day to bump it back to the top.
tips: Don’t spam other groups with your link. It gets you reported and can get your number banned.

items.q: Can I share my WhatsApp group link on Instagram, Facebook or Telegram?
items.tldr: Yep. Tap the share button on your card and pick the app. 📲
steps: Find your group here and tap the share button (the three dots) on its card.
Pick WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, X or Reddit, or tap Copy.
For Instagram, paste the copied link in your bio or add it as a Link sticker in Stories.
tips: The ShareYourGroup link shows your description and safety tips before people join, so you get fewer randoms.

items.q: How do I move my group back to the top of the list?
items.tldr: Submit the same link again. Works once every 24 hours. ⬆️
steps: Paste the same invite link in the box at the top.
Tap Drop it and Publish.
If it’s been 24 hours since the last bump, your card jumps back to the top.

items.q: How do I reset my group link or remove my listing?
items.tldr: Reset the invite link in WhatsApp; the old listing dies at our next check. 🧹
steps: Open the group → tap its name → Invite via link.
Tap Reset link and confirm.
The old link stops working, and its card is removed at our next check.
Want the group listed again? Submit the new link.
tips: Your card’s name and photo refresh from WhatsApp automatically. Change them in WhatsApp.
Need it gone faster? Contact us with the link.

items.q: Why was my group rejected or removed?
items.tldr: It broke a sharing rule, the link stopped working, or people reported it. 🚫
steps: Rules: no adult or 18+ stuff, no “earn money” or money-doubling scams, no selling numbers or OTPs, no hate, violence or drugs.
Dead link: the link was reset, the group was deleted, or it’s full.
Reports: several visitors flagged it.
Fixed it or reset your link? Just submit the new link.

items.q: Is it safe to join WhatsApp groups from the internet?
items.tldr: It can be, if you treat members like strangers and lock your privacy first. 🛡️
steps: Set your Profile photo, About and Last seen to My contacts (Settings → Privacy).
Never pay to join a group, and never share OTPs, PINs or bank details.
Don’t open APK files or links that ask you to install apps.
Something feels off? Leave, report it in WhatsApp, and tap the 🚩 on its card here.
items.note: We block adult, scam and hate listings, re-check links and hide reported groups, but we don’t run or moderate the groups themselves.

items.q: How do I spot a scam WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: Easy money, “VIP” fees, task jobs or anyone asking for OTPs = run. 🚩
steps: Promises like “earn ₹5,000 daily”, “double your money” or “guaranteed profit”.
“Task” jobs: like videos, rate hotels or review maps for money.
Paying to join a “VIP” group, or a “registration fee” for a job.
Anyone asking for OTPs, UPI PINs or screen sharing.
APK files or links telling you to install an app.
tips: Real groups never charge you to join. Leave, report it in WhatsApp and flag it here.

items.q: What should I never share in a WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: OTPs, passwords, UPI PIN, bank or card details, Aadhaar/PAN photos and your live location. Ever. 🔐
steps: No real bank, company, recruiter or admin will ask for these on WhatsApp.
If someone does, block and report them right away.

items.q: How do I report a WhatsApp group?
items.tldr: Group name → scroll down → Report group. Then flag it here too. 🚨
steps: Open the group and tap its name at the top.
Scroll down and tap Report group.
Choose whether to also exit the group, then confirm. WhatsApp gets the last few messages to review.
Back here, tap the 🚩 on the group’s card and pick a reason. Listings with several reports are hidden automatically.

items.q: What do I do if someone in a group harasses or scams me?
items.tldr: Screenshot, block, report, leave. Lost money in India? Call 1930 fast. 🆘
steps: Take screenshots of the chat and the person’s number.
Tap their name or number → Block and Report.
Leave the group.
Lost money? In India call the cyber-crime helpline 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in as soon as possible, and tell your bank.

items.q: What is ShareYourGroup?
items.tldr: A free directory to find and share WhatsApp group and channel links. 💚
steps: Owners add their groups by category: jobs, education, earning, gaming, friendship and more.
You search them by topic, city or country and join in one tap.
We re-check links and remove dead or reported ones regularly.

items.q: Is ShareYourGroup part of WhatsApp or Meta?
items.tldr: No, we’re an independent directory. 🙌
steps: WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. We’re not connected to them.
For problems with your WhatsApp account, use WhatsApp support in the app: Settings → Help.

items.q: How do I send a WhatsApp message without saving the number?
items.tldr: Use our free tool, or open wa.me/ + the full number. 💬
steps: Open our WhatsApp message tool.
Pick the country code, e.g. +91 for India.
Type the number without the first 0.
Write your message (optional) and tap Open in WhatsApp. The chat opens, no contact saved.
tips: Manual way: open https://wa.me/919876543210 in your browser (country code + number, no + or spaces).

items.q: How is ShareYourGroup free?
items.tldr: Ads and a few partner links pay the bills. Listing and joining stay free, always. 🆓
steps: Ads and partner cards are always marked sponsored.
We never charge to list, bump or join a group.

items.q: How do I contact ShareYourGroup or ask for a removal?
items.tldr: Use the contact page and include the group link. 📩
steps: Open the Contact page.
Add your name, email and the group link.
Tell us what’s up (removal, report, partnership) and hit Send message.
